categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, and sales of injection molding molds and plastic components. The core business is automotive injection molding molds, which accounted for 85.28% of total revenue in 2023. The company also produces plastic parts and components, representing 13.97% of revenue. Additionally, the company has expanded into high-polymer new materials business through its subsidiary.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including CAD/CAE/CAM integrated design, three-dimensional design, high-speed machining, rapid prototyping, virtual simulation, and robot technology. Core proprietary technologies include physical foaming mold technology, chemical foaming mold technology, multi-color molding technology, in-mold decoration (IMD/INS) technology, and low-pressure injection molding technology. The company utilizes advanced equipment including five-axis deep drilling machines, high-speed milling centers, and injection molding machines ranging from 90 to 3,200 tons.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves the automotive industry, supplying molds to major international automotive interior and exterior component suppliers including Faurecia, SMG, IAC, Grupo Antolin, Yanfeng, Plastic Omnium, Magna, and Adient. Products are used by major automotive brands including General Motors, Volkswagen, Audi, Porsche, Renault, Ford, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Jaguar Land Rover, and Volvo, as well as Chinese automakers and new energy vehicle manufacturers including BYD, Geely, and Nio.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Qingdao, Shandong Province. International operations include subsidiaries in Thailand (Qingdao Hi-Tech Moulds & Plastics (Thailand) Co., Ltd.) and Europe (Qingdao Hi-Tech Moulds & Plastics (Europe) SARL). The company has established after-sales service partnerships in France, North America, Germany, Italy, Spain, Mexico, Turkey, and Brazil. In 2023, foreign sales represented 75.35% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the supply chain as a mold manufacturer and supplier. It provides molds and plastic components to automotive interior and exterior component suppliers (Tier 1 suppliers), which then supply to automotive manufacturers (OEMs). The company also produces plastic components directly for some customers, positioning it at both the mold manufacturing and plastic parts production stages.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes digital and intelligent manufacturing, with focus on CAD/CAE/CAM technology integration, cloud platform development, and industrial internet applications. R&D investments target new molding technologies including foaming molds, multi-color molding, in-mold decoration, and low-pressure injection molding. The company emphasizes lightweight design molds for automotive applications and has established partnerships with universities including Qingdao University of Science and Technology for collaborative research and development.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of injection molding molds and plastic components to automotive suppliers and manufacturers. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of products, typically upon final inspection and acceptance for domestic sales or upon export customs clearance for international sales. The company operates on a project-based, made-to-order business model with customized products for each customer.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer of precision automotive injection molding molds. It competes in a market characterized by 'low-end chaos, high-end shortage,' where the company operates in the high-end segment. The company has been recognized as a 'National Key Backbone Enterprise for Large Precision Injection Molding Molds' and maintains strategic supplier status with major international customers like Faurecia. Competition is based on technical capability, quality, delivery speed, and cost efficiency.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of 572.44 million yuan, representing 14.41% growth compared to 500.32 million yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 23.29 million yuan in 2023, declining 57.17% from 54.37 million yuan in 2022, primarily due to increased operating expenses and asset impairment provisions. Total assets reached 1.85 billion yuan at year-end 2023, up 39.08% from 1.33 billion yuan in 2022, reflecting significant capital investments in new production facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through advanced precision manufacturing capabilities, proprietary molding technologies, and comprehensive one-stop service delivery including mold design, manufacturing, debugging, and after-sales support. The company emphasizes high precision, stability, and extended mold lifespan, supported by ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 certifications. Key differentiators include rapid product development cycles, customized solutions for complex automotive components, and strong technical support for new energy vehicle applications.
